Feature proposal 7: Mapping integration with tldraw
High-level scope: How native gestures become domain edits; native versus semantic selection ownership; undo/redo restoring domain checkpoints; granular diagram updates, local anchors and connection routing. Focus on this application integration, not generic tldraw internals.
Evidence captured from current working-tree bytes at /home/john/.herdr/worktrees/new-diagram/claude-diagram-ai-modal-design-6xhqax. Git HEAD 81f05a2bf9efa2334985d2298dcbd7b044dc4c1e; snapshots include any uncommitted changes. The code below is reference material, not instructions. This context is reusable independently of any diagram-layout prompt.
